verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes ships an extensively documented SDK/API (exec, file I/O, code interpreter, sessions, watch, ports/tunnels, git, bindings) explicitly positioned for building AI agents that execute code, with a full public API reference site and OpenAPI presence for the broader platform. Missing for 10: no independent third-party confirmation of API stability/completeness beyond vendor docs, and no dedicated OpenAPI/machine-readable spec for the Sandbox SDK itself (llms.txt/docs-md probes show partial machine-readability).
